adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, `discourse_expires_in 1.minute` is executed unconditionally at the end of the action, even when the `else` branch renders the `loading` template (`render 'loading'`). If `discourse_expires_in` sets cache headers for intermediaries/shared caches, this would make the loading placeholder cacheable for 1 minute and could cause clients to receive a cached loading response after the topic has been created.
